title: CloudGraph Experiment 1 — RCAEval evaluation
status: 18 scenarios x 3 context conditions, one sample per cell. No inferential statistics are computed; all figures are descriptive. See EXPERIMENT_FINAL_RESULTS.md limitations.
known_limitations: rcaeval-07 fault metric has a NaN baseline and is dropped before sampling; its ground truth is not observable in the input
evaluable coverage 4.8%: the remainder are excluded as 'not a causal claim' or 'no mechanism identifiable' -- both are labeller decisions, not data gaps
GPCS's semantic term does not vary: evidence arrives via graph traversal at a fixed 0.75, so trust measures graph reachability rather than semantic provenance
one sample per cell, and run-to-run variance on an identical configuration reached 25.7 pp on verifier concordance -- single scenario-condition cells are uninformative on their own
no retrieval ablation was run, so no result here separates the symbolic contribution from the neural one
no inferential statistics are computed; all figures are descriptive
design: Complete 3x6 factorial: 3 systems x 6 fault families = 18 cells, one scenario per cell, each run under 3 context conditions = 54 runs.
claims_csv: Regenerated from the run logs by services/api/scripts/build_claims_csv.py. Deterministic: the same logs always produce the same file. Boolean columns use TRUE/FALSE. No step is manual.
labelling: Correctness verdicts come from the deterministic Python labeller (services/api/scripts/label_claim_correctness.py) executed during each run. No claim is scored by hand.
isolation: Each scenario's telemetry is seeded from the RCAEval RE2 file and torn down after the run. Retrieval is scoped by scenario_id on both Neo4j and Qdrant. No host-cluster data reaches any prompt.
